_comment: Event data for the bulletin board. Recurring rules generate weekly events automatically; overrides modify or cancel a specific date's recurring event; specials are one-off events. Times are 24h US Eastern. Poster paths are relative to the site root (e.g. posters/2026-08-20-cube-night.png) and optional everywhere.

overrides.note: Example only — for format reference. action is 'cancel' or 'replace'; a replace may supply any of what/start/end/where/poster to change just those fields.

overrides.what: Jared's Birthday Draft-Ahead: Bangers Only Roto Draft

specials.note: Example only — remove when adding the first real special event.
